name: Nee ♥ Summer! 2 ~Nee ♥ Sama!~
source:
Yuta Yamauchi and Kei Higashide became a couple on a sunny day. The two started living together and lived in peace, but Yuta's sister and Kei's nemesis, Otoha Yamauchi, came over. When Otoha learns that his younger brother lives with Kei, she refuses to recognize the relationship between the two and comes up with certain conditions. Yuta and Kei struggle together to get Otoha's recognition.

[From [url=https://ja.m.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E5%A7%89SUMMER!2]Wikipedia[/url]]
translation:
山内优太与东出圭在一个晴朗的日子里成为恋人。两人开始同居，过着平静的生活。然而，优太的姐姐、也是圭的宿敌山内音羽突然来访。得知弟弟正与圭同住后，音羽拒绝承认两人的关系，并提出若干条件。为了获得音羽认可，优太与圭携手努力。

[摘自[url=https://ja.m.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E5%A7%89SUMMER!2]Wikipedia[/url]]
